# Plans

All plans generated during development or task execution must be saved as Markdown files in the `.github/plans/` directory.

## Rules

- Save every generated plan to `.github/plans/` using a descriptive kebab-case filename (e.g., `.github/plans/add-caching-layer.md`).
- Include a clear title, date, and summary at the top of each plan file.
- Plans should be committed to the repository so they are available for future reference.
